title: The Organoid Reconstitution Assay (ORA) for the Functional Analysis of Intestinal Stem and Niche Cells
protocol: Autoclave 1 set of intestinal scissors, normal scissors, and forceps in a sterile container.
Place a 96-well (flat bottom) dish in an incubator at 37 °C.
Prepare 10 mL of complete culture medium with the reagents listed in table of materials.
Incubate the complete medium at 37 °C in a water bath.
Thaw reconstituted basement membrane by placing it in an ice bucket.
Fill 4 Petri dishes with cold phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) at 4 °C.
Sacrifice a Lgr5-eGFP-IRES-CreERt2 mouse on a C57BL6/J background by CO2 inhalation.
Dissect the peritoneum longitudinally with a pair of scissors.
Hold the stomach with forceps and cut it transversally in half.
Place intestinal scissors into the stomach using the blunt tip and gently push through the pylorus.
Cut the intestine with scissors and pull with forceps, placing it in a Petri dish containing PBS.
Wash the whole small intestine in cold PBS by holding it with forceps and gently rinsing it with U-shaped movements.
Flatten the intestine on a cutting board, luminal side up.
Gently remove the villi from the flattened intestine using a glass slide.
Scrape the flattened intestine twice along its entire length.
Cut the small intestine into 2-5 mm pieces with a sterile surgical blade.
Place the cut intestine in a 50 mL tube containing 10 mL of ice cold PBS.
Clean tissue fragments by pipetting them up and down in PBS, discarding supernatant until PBS is clear.
Add 15 mL cold PBS to bring final volume to 25 mL.
Incubate tissue with 2 mM EDTA for 45 min on a roller at 4°C.
Discard the PBS/EDTA mixture.
Add 10 mL of PBS and detach crypts by harshly pipetting up and down at least three times.
Collect supernatant containing detached crypts.
Repeat step four times to ensure all crypts are detached.
Add culture medium to reach a final volume of 50 mL.
Pellet cells by centrifuging at 300 x g for 5 min.
Resuspend pellet in 10 mL of culture medium.
Centrifuge again at 80 x g for 3 min to pellet crypts.
Discard the supernatant of pelleted crypts.
Resuspend the crypts in 1 mL trypsin-like enzymes with 50 μL DNAse at 50 µg/mL concentration.
Incubate the cells in a water bath at 32 °C for 2 min.
Add 10 mL of culture medium to the mixture.
Harshly pipette up and down at least 5 times to dissociate crypts into single cells.
Filter the solution through a 40 µm strainer to eliminate clumps and impurities.
Pellet the single cells at 300 x g for 5 min.
Prepare 50 mL of 1x Hank's buffered salt solution or HBSS/2% fetal cow serum (FCS) solution.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL for every 10^6 cells using the prepared solution.
Add BV421 Lin- (CD31, CD45, TER119) at a concentration of 1:100 to the cell suspension.
Add CD24-APC and CD117-PE antibodies at concentrations of 1:250 each to the cell suspension.
Incubate the cells with antibodies for 30 min.
Sort Lgr5+ stem cells into separate low bind tubes.
Sort Paneth cells into separate low bind tubes.
Centrifuge the sorted cells at 300 x g for 5 min.
Resuspend the cells in 100 μL of medium containing components as described in section 1.3 (see Table of Materials).
Treat the Paneth cells with chemical or genetic modification (n = 2000).
Treat the Lgr5+ stem cells with chemical or genetic modification (n = 2000).
Use 5 µL of liposome-mediated transfection reagent in a total volume of 100 µL culture medium and small interfering RNA (siRNA) at a concentration of 100 nM for cell treatment.
Incubate the mixture for 30 min at 37 °C or for the necessary time according to chosen modifications.
Wash cells twice in 500 μL culture medium.
Centrifuge cells at 300 x g for 5 min and resuspend in 10 µL of culture medium.
Pool Paneth and Lgr5+ cells in a total volume of 20 µl, centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 min at room temperature (RT).
Co-incubate the pooled cell types for 10 minutes at RT.
Remove 10 μL supernatant carefully without disturbing the pellet.
Add 30 µL reconstituted basement membrane to cells, resuspend and plate in a pre-warmed 96 well plate.
After 10 min, add 200 µL of complete medium.
Change the medium every 48 hours.
Count organoid multiplicity at day 5.
